It's Fall! Time for the Fall Extravaganzas! What is the best waxed jacket? The best denim jacket? The best sports coat/blazer? What about suede jackets?! Carhartt jackets?! There are just far too many things for us to possible cover in one video. However, we did cover quite a bit. Below is a little list of what we touched upon.

1. A Shearling/Sherpa Vest
2. A Knit Vest
3. A Columbia Brand Cardigan (before omni-heat)
4. A Lido Worsted Ski Sweater
5. GAP Lambswool Sweater
6. Inis Meáin Silk and Alpaca Blend
7. The Iron Snail Billy Goat
8. SEH Kelly Balcamaan
9. SEH Kelly SB Jacket
10. Vintage (L.L. Bean) Field Jacket 
11. Ralph Lauren Andrew Pant (Cordury & Grey)
12. BRUT Sweater
13. Lady White Sweater
14. Taylor Stitch Division Shirt in Birch
15. Filson Tin Cloth Short Lined Cruiser Jacket
16. Filson Wool Work Jacket
17. Levi's 90's Made in USA 90's Pants
18. Ralph Lauren Vintage Blanket Lined Denim
19. Tuf Nut Selvedge Denim Jacket
20. Boy Scouts Wool Jacket
21. Imogene + Willie Sawtooth Overshirt
22. Lee Storm Rider Denim Jacket
23. Carhartt Made in Canada Blanket Lined (Storm Rider) Denim Jacket
24. Vintage Suede and Sherpa Leather Jacket

The Iron Snail is a men’s fashion vlog starring a young man named Michael and featuring a snail no bigger than a quarter. The two are set on taking over the world of fashion by creating a clothing line to end all clothing lines. Until then, we’re here to tell you EVERYTHING you need to know about the best clothing out there, from the highest quality raw denim jeans to the warmest jackets to the sturdiest boots…the Iron Snail has got you covered. (written by Taylor, though Michael is sometimes known to talk about himself in the third person… xoxo)
